examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the Application Accelerator page places it: the claim and a large "Learn more" text button (`kind: 'transparent'`) beside a one-file sample, drawn with a filename bar. Edit the props in the Controls panel — add a second file to get a tab strip, or a `secondaryAction` for a second button.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CodeSplit from '@aziontech/webkit/code-split'

  const codeTabs = [
    {
      label: 'cache-settings.json',
      value: 'cache-settings',
      language: 'json',
      code: '{\n  "cache_settings": {\n    "name": "api-cache",\n    "browser_cache_settings": {\n      "ttl": 60\n    },\n    "cdn_cache_settings": {\n      "ttl": 30\n    },\n    "cache_key": {\n      "query_string": "whitelist",\n      "query_string_fields": ["user_id", "category"],\n      "cookie": "whitelist",\n      "cookie_names": ["session_id", "region"]\n    },\n    "methods": ["GET", "POST", "OPTIONS"],\n    "stale_cache": true\n  }\n}',
      fileName: 'cache-settings.json',
      fileIcon: 'ai ai-json'
    }
  ]

  const primaryAction = {
    label: 'Learn more',
    href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/products/build/applications/application-accelerator/',
    trailing: true,
    kind: 'transparent'
  }
</script>

<template>
  <CodeSplit
    title="From basic caching to advanced acceleration"
    description="Application Accelerator extends Cache with protocol optimizations and advanced cache rules for dynamic content."
    :code-tabs="codeTabs"
    copy-aria-label="Copy the cache settings sample"
    :primary-action="primaryAction"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Default file
examples.summary: Three files with `defaultFile` opening the handler, the second tab, first; an unknown value falls back to the first tab. The band carries an `anchor` for in-page links.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CodeSplit from '@aziontech/webkit/code-split'

  const codeTabs = [
    {
      label: 'azion.config.js',
      value: 'config',
      language: 'javascript',
      code: "export default {\n  build: { preset: 'javascript' },\n  rules: {\n    request: [{ name: 'Run the handler', match: '^/', behavior: { runFunction: 'handler' } }]\n  }\n}",
      fileName: 'azion.config.js',
      fileIcon: 'ai-cor ai-js'
    },
    {
      label: 'main.js',
      value: 'handler',
      language: 'javascript',
      code: "export default {\n  async fetch(request) {\n    const url = new URL(request.url)\n\n    if (url.pathname === '/api/status') {\n      return Response.json({ region: 'edge', ok: true })\n    }\n\n    return fetch(request)\n  }\n}",
      fileName: 'main.js',
      fileIcon: 'ai-cor ai-js'
    },
    {
      label: 'package.json',
      value: 'package',
      language: 'json',
      code: '{\n  "name": "acme-store",\n  "type": "module",\n  "scripts": {\n    "deploy": "azion deploy"\n  }\n}',
      fileName: 'package.json',
      fileIcon: 'ai ai-json'
    }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <CodeSplit
    anchor="handler"
    title="Answer the request before it reaches the origin"
    description="A function returns the response itself when a route needs logic, and passes everything else through."
    :code-tabs="codeTabs"
    default-file="handler"
    copy-aria-label="Copy the handler sample"
    :primary-action="{ label: 'Docs', href: '/docs/functions', trailing: true }"
  />
</template>
